verdict.rationale: Morph's own docs say prefix caching is enabled automatically for every open-source model, with no configuration and no cache-write surcharge, so the capability exists first-party. The docs quoted here do not state the actual benefit the story asks for (lower latency or a cached-token discount on repeated context), and caching is limited to open-source models. missing for 10: explicit documentation of cached-token pricing discounts or latency reduction on cache hits, coverage beyond open-source models (e.g., the specialized tools), cache behavior details such as TTL or minimum prefix length, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can benefit from prompt/prefix caching that reduces latency or cost on repeated context

citations.quote: Prefix caching is on for every open source model. No configuration, no cache-write surcharge.
